title: LLM Model Abstraction Layer
summary: This module defines abstract interfaces and concrete implementations for interacting with Large Language Models (LLMs), including mechanisms for fallback, function-based models, structured generation, and concurrency control.

nodes.label: Abstract LLM Interface
nodes.title: Model (Abstract Base Class)
nodes.description: Defines the core contract and common functionalities for interacting with Large Language Models, including request handling, token counting, and message preparation.

nodes.label: Streamed Response Handler
nodes.title: StreamedResponse (Abstract Base Class)
nodes.description: Manages and processes real-time, chunked responses from LLMs, providing an asynchronous iterator for stream events and accumulating usage data.

nodes.label: Fallback Model Logic
nodes.title: FallbackModel
nodes.description: Provides resilience by chaining multiple LLMs and attempting them in sequence until a successful response is received or a configured fallback condition is met.

nodes.label: Function-Backed Model
nodes.title: FunctionModel
nodes.description: Allows local Python functions to simulate LLM behavior, useful for testing, mocking, or integrating custom logic as an LLM.

nodes.label: MCP Sampling Integration
nodes.title: MCPSamplingModel
nodes.description: Integrates with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server to enable model sampling, where the MCP server makes requests back to the client.

nodes.label: Outlines Structured Generation
nodes.title: OutlinesModel
nodes.description: Adapts local or offline LLMs for structured output generation by leveraging the Outlines library, supporting various local model backends.

nodes.label: Model Wrapper Base
nodes.title: WrapperModel
nodes.description: A foundational class for models that extend or modify the behavior of other models by wrapping an existing model instance.

nodes.label: Concurrency Limiter
nodes.title: limit_model_concurrency
nodes.description: A utility function to wrap an LLM with concurrency limiting, controlling the number of simultaneous requests to prevent overload.

nodes.label: HTTP Client Cache
nodes.title: cached_async_http_client
nodes.description: Provides a cached asynchronous HTTP client for efficient and reusable network requests to LLM providers.

nodes.label: Model Configuration
nodes.title: ModelSettings
nodes.description: Data structure specifying various settings and parameters for LLM interactions, such as temperature, max tokens, and stop sequences.

nodes.label: Request Parameters
nodes.title: ModelRequestParameters
nodes.description: Defines the specific parameters for a single LLM request, including function tools, output format, and instruction parts.

nodes.label: Conversation Messages
nodes.title: ModelMessage
nodes.description: Represents the history of messages exchanged with an LLM, including user prompts, system instructions, and model responses.

nodes.label: Token & Cost Usage
nodes.title: RequestUsage
nodes.description: Tracks the input and output token counts, as well as estimated costs, associated with LLM calls.

nodes.label: Model Capability Profile
nodes.title: ModelProfile
nodes.description: Describes the features, limitations, and supported native tools of a specific LLM, guiding how requests are prepared and handled.

nodes.label: LLM Provider APIs
nodes.title: LLM Provider APIs
nodes.description: External services or modules that provide access to various LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini).

nodes.label: MCP Server
nodes.title: MCP Server
nodes.description: The Model Context Protocol server, used for collaborative model interactions and sampling.

nodes.label: Outlines Library
nodes.title: Outlines Library
nodes.description: An external Python library for constrained text generation with local LLMs, enabling structured outputs.

groups.label: Core Abstractions
groups.title: Core Model Abstractions
groups.description: Fundamental interfaces for defining and handling LLM interactions and their streaming responses.

groups.label: Model Implementations
groups.title: Concrete Model Implementations
groups.description: Various concrete implementations of the LLM interface, providing specialized behaviors like fallback, function-based logic, or integration with external libraries.

groups.label: Utilities
groups.title: Model Utilities
groups.description: Helper functions and components that enhance or support LLM interactions, such as concurrency control and HTTP client management.

groups.label: Configuration & Data
groups.title: Model Configuration & Data Structures
groups.description: Data structures and settings used to configure LLM behavior, define request parameters, and represent conversational messages and usage metrics.
